description:
• Sobre a Payfy

    • A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte.

    Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.

    • Sobre a vaga:

    Designer de Conteúdo com IA é quem projeta, produz e publica o conteúdo da nossa plataforma de transformação com IA para times financeiros — do começo ao fim.

    Projetar vem primeiro, e é o que define a função: pensar a pauta antes de executá-la, decidir se ela vira carrossel ou vídeo, onde ela entra no calendário e o que precisa dizer. Depois vem a execução — desenhar a peça, editar o vídeo, escrever a copy e colocar no ar. Tudo com a mesma pessoa, do início ao fim.

    É uma posição nova no mercado e já é realidade aqui: a Payfy tem profissionais no time atuando exatamente assim.

    O que torna esse escopo possível é a forma como a gente trabalha. Ferramentas de IA generativa (Claude/Claude Design, entre outras) estão na rotina diária e absorvem a parte mecânica da execução — variações de peça, primeiro corte, versões de copy, adaptação de formato. Some a isso um acervo de vídeo já montado (padrões de título, vinheta, GC, mockups, backgrounds animados) e um sistema visual definido: você quase nunca começa do zero.

    Por isso o perfil é generalista: repertório em design, vídeo e social media, e critério para decidir o que publicar, em que ordem e com que cara. É aí que seu tempo vai — o trabalho braçal fica com a IA.

    Você vai ter autonomia real sobre a operação e apoio direto de quem já construiu todo o padrão visual e narrativo da marca.

    O que você vai fazer:

    Calendário e planejamento

    • Montar o calendário editorial mensal
    • Traduzir temas, lançamentos e novidades da plataforma em pautas de conteúdo
    • Manter a régua de publicação rodando de forma previsível, sem depender de demanda chegar

    Produção visual

    • Criar carrosséis, posts estáticos, stories e peças para mídia paga dentro da identidade da marca
    • Produzir capas de conteúdo para a plataforma (cursos, aulas, eventos)
    • Manter rigor estético e consistência de marca em tudo que sai

    Vídeo

    • Editar as videoaulas e conteúdos diversos a partir de um acervo de assets já prontos
    • Realizar cortes, encaixes, montagem e exportação
    • Apoiar novas gravações quando entrarem no calendário

    Publicação e acompanhamento

    • Agendar e publicar via MLabs e canais próprios
    • Conferir se a postagem subiu, se ficou correta, se precisa de ajuste
    • Contribuir com ideias para materiais ricos (e-books, planilhas, ferramentas usadas como isca)

    O que a gente espera de você:

    Requisitos

    • Experiência prévia montando calendários de social media (não apenas executando peças)
    • Experiência prévia editando vídeo — domínio dos princípios de enquadramento, ritmo e montagem
    • Boas noções de design: hierarquia, contraste, uso de cor, composição. Você não precisa desenhar do zero, mas precisa saber enxergar quando algo está errado
    • Boa escrita: headlines, copy de post, roteiro
    • Disciplina para trabalho remoto — organização própria, cumprimento de prazos, comunicação ativa
    • Disposição real para aprender ferramentas de IA e mudar a forma de trabalhar

    O perfil que a gente procura

    • Visão macro de projetos
    • Autonomia: pegar uma pauta e levá-la até a publicação, sem precisar de briefing mastigado a cada passo
    • Organização e consistência
    • Senso de dono

    Diferenciais

    • Experiência com Adobe Premiere, After Effects, CapCut
    • Familiaridade com Figma, Notion, MLabs
    • Já ter usado ferramentas de IA generativa para produção de conteúdo
    • Conhecimento de boas práticas de YouTube (SEO de descrição, configuração de publicação, leitura de retenção)
    • Repertório em finanças/B2B

    Como é trabalhar aqui:

    • Remoto de verdade, com rituais definidos: alinhamento semanal com o time e encontros de acompanhamento com o gestor direto ao longo da semana
    • Aprendizado estruturado, você vai lapidar seus conhecimentos em: MLabs, boas práticas de IA aplicada a conteúdo, padrão de edição dos vídeos, produto e marca
    • Espaço para crescer

    Processo seletivo:

    1. Inscrição e triagem de currículo — RH
    2. Envio de portfólio — 3 peças autorais, sendo obrigatoriamente uma delas um vídeo editado por você
    3. Teste perfil comportamental (DISC) — RH
    4. Desafio prático — um projeto integrado e realista: uma peça de design, um carrossel, um vídeo curto e a copy/headline que amarra tudo, a partir de um tema que a gente entrega. O que a gente avalia aqui é sobretudo o raciocínio: como você estruturou o conjunto, não só o acabamento de cada peça
    5. Entrevista técnica — com o gestor direto, junto com a devolutiva do desafio
    6. Entrevista de liderança — com a liderança de Marketing

    O que oferecemos

    • Contrato CLT — R$ 4.000,00
    • Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe
    • Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses)
    • Day off de aniversário
    • Wellhub + Conexa Saúde
    • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
    • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia

    Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy

    Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade.

    Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

    Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Criador De Conteúdo Sem Experiência :: Apostas Esportivas & Igaming
description:
SOBRE A VAGA

A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (iGaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.

Estamos buscando pessoas sem experiência prévia em criação de conteúdo que queiram aprender, na prática, a produzir vídeos curtos para redes sociais e ser remuneradas por isso desde o primeiro vídeo.

Não exigimos portfólio, equipamento profissional ou seguidores. Exigimos disposição para aprender e consistência.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

Gravar vídeos curtos (formato reels/shorts) usando apenas um celular, seguindo as diretrizes fornecidas pela Doppa.

Produzir conteúdo para marcas parceiras devidamente licenciadas pela SPA/MF (Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas).

Evoluir dentro da trilha de progressão da Doppa conforme volume e qualidade dos vídeos.

PONTOS DE ATENÇÃO

É imprescindível ter mais do que 18 anos para se candidatar.

Trabalhamos exclusivamente com operadores licenciados pela SPA/MF e seguimos rigorosamente a Portaria SPA/MF nº 1.231/2024, que regula a publicidade do setor de apostas no Brasil.

Toda comunicação produzida na Doppa segue diretrizes claras de transparência: identificação de parceria, exibição de licença e proibição de qualquer promessa de retorno garantido.

Não trabalhamos com discurso de "ganhar dinheiro fácil". Trabalhamos com formação real de criadores dentro de um setor regulamentado, sério e em expansão.

title: Accounting Manager - Remote (Work From Anywhere)
description:
MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. In India, we are building finance leaders who go beyond execution and take ownership of teams, processes, and client outcomes.

This is not a traditional accounting manager role. You will lead accounting operations for US clients while mentoring and developing your team in a fast-moving environment.

The Opportunity

As an Accounting Manager, you will oversee end-to-end accounting operations for US clients, managing a team of accountants and working directly with US Controllers and CFOs. You will be a key finance partner responsible for accuracy, scalability, and continuous process improvement.

What You Will Own

  • Lead end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients
  • Manage and mentor a team of accountants ensuring quality and professional growth
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles
  • Review and finalize financial statements in compliance with US GAAP
  • Manage multi-location revenue accounting, COGS tracking, and operational expense reconciliations
  • Act as primary US client contact, building strong stakeholder relationships
  • Partner with Controllers and CFOs to support reporting and financial insights
  • Drive process automation and workflow improvements
  • Ensure audit readiness and manage auditor interactions

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP expertise
  • Prior experience in team management or mentoring
  • Background in hospitality, restaurant tech, or multi-location businesses a strong plus
  • Strong understanding of close cycles, financial reporting, and internal controls
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Toast, QuickBooks, or similar)
  • CA / CPA (or equivalent) strongly preferred
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap

Why Join MAVI?

  • Lead finance for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Build and manage high-performing accounting teams
  • High ownership and direct visibility with US leadership
  • Fast-track career path to Finance Controller and Head of Finance roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

title: Especialista Em Operações Cripto E Carteiras Digitais
description:
Sobre a vaga

Se você já perdeu o sono acompanhando uma liquidez secar numa DEX às 3h da manhã, ou já organizou uma migração de fundos entre cold wallets sem deixar ninguém dormir tranquilo até a confirmação final na blockchain — essa vaga é para você.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional experiente para assumir as operações críticas de ativos digitais da empresa: exchanges, carteiras e custódia. Não é uma posição para quem está começando na área. É uma função de responsabilidade real, com acesso a ativos reais, decisões que importam e impacto direto no negócio.

O que você vai fazer
  • Executar e supervisionar operações em exchanges centralizadas (CEX) e descentralizadas (DEX) — negociação, transferências, liquidez e reconciliação
  • Gerenciar hot wallets e cold wallets no dia a dia, garantindo segurança operacional sem travar a velocidade do negócio
  • Administrar estruturas multi-sig e processos de custódia, incluindo definição e revisão de políticas de acesso e aprovação
  • Monitorar exposição, saldos e movimentações de ativos cripto em tempo real
  • Criar e aprimorar processos internos de controle, segurança e auditoria para operações com criptoativos
  • Atuar como referência técnica em questões de segurança de carteiras, gestão de chaves e prevenção de perdas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de compliance, financeiro e tecnologia para manter as operações sólidas e escaláveis
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada operando em exchanges cripto, tanto CEX quanto DEX
  • Vivência prática com carteiras digitais — hot wallets, cold wallets, soluções multi-sig e custódia de ativos
  • Histórico real de gestão de operações com criptoativos (não apenas conhecimento teórico)
  • Rigor com segurança operacional: você entende que um erro nessa área pode custar caro, literalmente
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões e comunicar com clareza em ambientes de alta responsabilidade
  • Inglês para comunicação técnica é um diferencial
O que oferecemos
  • Remuneração: US$ 130.000 a US$ 150.000 por ano
  • Plano de saúde completo , sem letras miúdas
  • Modelo de trabalho flexível: remoto ou híbrido, conforme sua preferência
  • Autonomia real para estruturar e melhorar processos, não apenas executar
  • Um time que já entende do assunto — sem precisar explicar o que é gas fee

Não importa a cor da pele, raça, gênero, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica pessoal. Avaliamos todos os candidatos exclusivamente pelo conhecimento e experiência.

Se você respira mercado cripto e sabe a diferença entre segurança de verdade e segurança de fachada, queremos falar com você.

title: Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court / Removal Defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)

  • Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.).
  • Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions.
  • Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records.
  • Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation.
  • Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates.
  • Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy.
  • Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.

What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills

  • Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese.
  • 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation).
  • Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills.
  • Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload.
  • Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

  • Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments.
  • Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
  • Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused.
  • A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 + years of immigration paralegal experience.
  • Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Planejador Financeiro / Consultor De Investimentos (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:

O Grupo Capital:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todosos dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar deforma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial:

  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá:

  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de umtime de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidadede horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Modo de contratação:

  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Servicenow Platform Architect
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Estamos procurando um(a) Platform Architect experiente para atuar como um importante consultor de arquitetura para nossos clientes. O principal objetivo desta função é garantir que os clientes obtenham o máximo valor de seu investimento em ServiceNow. O(a) Platform Architect orientará os clientes na identificação e no sequenciamento da adoção de capacidades alinhadas aos seus resultados de negócio, proporcionando geração de valor de forma rápida e sustentável, além de garantir a saúde, a escalabilidade e a sustentabilidade da plataforma no longo prazo. Esta é uma função de caráter consultivo, focada em definir a estratégia e a direção da plataforma do cliente por meio de orientação especializada, e não por meio de implementação direta.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento da Plataforma ServiceNow: Entendimento aprofundado da plataforma ServiceNow, incluindo seu modelo de dados (CMDB, CSDM), padrões de desenvolvimento de aplicações, capacidades de integração, modelo de segurança e gestão do ciclo de vida das instâncias.
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura: Experiência em princípios de design de soluções, frameworks de governança, remediação de dívida técnica e conceitos de arquitetura corporativa (por exemplo, TOGAF).
  • Conhecimento de Workflows e Produtos: Conhecimento aprofundado em ITSM é obrigatório. Também é esperado domínio em pelo menos uma outra área de workflow do ServiceNow (por exemplo: ITOM, CSM, HRSD ou SecOps).
  • Certificações:
  • Obrigatórias : Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS - pelo menos uma).
  • Esperadas : ArchX - Advanced Architecture, Certified Technical Architect (CTA - em andamento ou concluída).Certificações em IA: Now Assist Essentials, Now Assist Executive Micro-Certification e Agentic AI Executive MicroCertification.

Atividades

  • Consultoria de Arquitetura: Traduzir os objetivos de negócio dos clientes em uma estratégia de plataforma coerente. Orientar os clientes na definição de seu roadmap de plataforma, no sequenciamento da adoção de workflows e na condução de revisões de design de soluções.
  • Saúde da Plataforma e Governança: Liderar discussões de governança técnica para estabelecer frameworks que previnam a degradação da saúde da plataforma ao longo do tempo. Interpretar relatórios de saúde da plataforma e aconselhar sobre planos de remediação relacionados à manutenibilidade, desempenho, segurança e capacidade de atualização.
  • Gestão de Riscos: Identificar, monitorar e avaliar proativamente riscos nas dimensões arquitetural, técnica e de saúde da plataforma. Orientar os clientes sobre estratégias de mitigação para garantir que os riscos sejam tratados antes de se tornarem incidentes.
  • Relacionamento com Clientes: Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders dos clientes, desde equipes técnicas até a alta liderança. Facilitar revisões arquiteturais, reuniões executivas e workshops.
  • Especialização Técnica: Demonstrar as capacidades da plataforma e orientar os clientes sobre as funcionalidades do ServiceNow. Manter conhecimento aprofundado em algumas áreaschave, ao mesmo tempo em que possui uma visão abrangente de toda a plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Especialização Estratégica e Conceitual em IA: Orientar os clientes na adoção de recursos de Inteligência Artificial na plataforma ServiceNow, incluindo aconselhamento sobre como essas capacidades se encaixam na estratégia organizacional mais ampla de IA e como alinhar as capacidades de IA aos resultados de negócio.

O que oferecemos?

Benefícios TCS – Brasil:

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche (SP)
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas, você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance

title: Sales Navigator Expert - 100% Remote
description:
Sales Navigator Expert - 100% Remote

Apply here:

Are you experienced in building targeted prospect lists and running cold outbound campaigns from start to finish? Do you know how to use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo , or similar platforms to identify the right decision-makers and turn cold prospects into qualified conversations?

We're looking for a Sales Navigator Expert to support a fractional CFO firm serving founder-led businesses across real estate, professional services, and technology-enabled companies. This is a hands-on outbound prospecting role , not an account management, customer success, or general administrative position.

About the Role

You'll be responsible for building and maintaining targeted prospect lists, executing cold outreach through LinkedIn and email, managing multi-touch follow-up sequences, qualifying responses, and booking discovery calls directly into the founder's calendar.

This role is ideal for someone who has personally built lead lists, researched prospects, run outbound sequences, and managed the prospecting process end-to-end. You won't be responsible for pitching or closing deals — your focus is creating a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities.

The position is approximately 20 hours per week , fully remote, with some daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours .

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain targeted B2B prospect lists based on a defined Ideal Client Profile (ICP).
  • Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify companies, decision-makers, and qualified prospects.
  • Use Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar sales intelligence platforms for list building, prospect research, and contact enrichment.
  • Run cold outbound campaigns through LinkedIn and email.
  • Build and execute consistent multi-touch outreach and follow-up sequences.
  • Personalize outbound messaging based on prospect and company research.
  • Qualify inbound responses generated through outbound campaigns.
  • Book qualified discovery calls directly into the founder's calendar.
  • Maintain accurate and organized prospect data in Excel, spreadsheets, or CRM systems.
  • Track lead status, outreach activity, follow-ups, and pipeline progression.
  • Report weekly on outreach volume, response rates, engagement, and booked discovery calls.
  • Continuously refine targeting, lists, and outreach execution based on campaign performance.
  • Take ownership of the outbound prospecting process with minimal day-to-day supervision.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–3+ years of proven experience in lead generation, B2B prospecting, cold outreach, SDR, BDR, or a similar outbound-focused role .
  • Real, hands-on experience building prospect lists from scratch , not simply working leads already provided by a company.
  • Someone who has personally built target lists and run outbound sequences in Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar
  • Hands-on experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator , including building, filtering, and saving targeted lead searches.
  • Experience using Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar sales intelligence and lead enrichment platforms .
  • Proven experience personally executing cold email and LinkedIn outreach sequences .
  • Strong understanding of outbound sequencing, follow-up cadence, prospect research, and lead qualification.
  • Ability to identify the right companies and decision-makers based on an ICP.
  • Experience maintaining lead pipelines and prospect data in Excel, spreadsheets, or CRM systems.
  • Excellent written English, with the ability to write professional outbound messages.
  • Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable working independently.
  • Results-oriented mindset with an understanding of outbound metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, engagement rates, and booked meetings.
  • Experience prospecting into real estate, property management, professional services, or B2B financial services is a strong plus.
  • Availability for some daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Do NOT Apply If

  • Your background is primarily in Account Management, Customer Success, or Customer Service without significant cold prospecting experience.
  • You have only worked leads that were already provided to you and have not personally built targeted prospect lists.
  • Your experience is primarily updating or logging activities in a CRM rather than actively sourcing prospects.
  • You have never personally run cold email or LinkedIn outreach campaigns .
  • You do not have hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator .
  • You have no experience with Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar prospecting/list-building platforms .
  • You are unfamiliar with outbound sequences, multi-touch follow-ups, and cold prospecting strategies.
  • You prefer account management or relationship management over proactive outbound prospecting.
  • You require constant supervision or detailed instructions to execute your daily outreach.
  • You are uncomfortable being measured on outreach volume, response rates, engagement, and booked discovery calls.

title: Account Manager
description:
We're Convert Sail, an e-commerce conversion optimization agency. We work with Shopify brands spending $100K-$1M+/month on ads, and we move fast. Really fast.

We're looking for an Account Manager to own client relationships and project delivery. You'll manage 8-10 client accounts, coordinate landing page and funnel builds with our design and dev team, and be the main point of contact when clients need something.

This isn't a 9-5 role where you clock out and forget about work. When a client has a launch on Saturday, you're online. When a project is behind, you stay late to fix it. We ship fast, we work weekends when it matters, and most people flame out in the first 90 days because they can't handle the pace.

If that scares you, this isn't the role for you.

If that excites you, keep reading.

What you'll do:

  • Own 8-10 client relationships and make sure they're happy, on track, and renewing long-term
  • Manage day-to-day client communication and set clear expectations
  • Coordinate landing page and funnel projects with our design and dev team—keep timelines tight and make sure nothing slips
  • Proactively identify and solve client issues before they become fires
  • Track project progress in ClickUp and ensure deadlines are met
  • Help clients see ROI from our work so they stick around for 6-12+ months, not 2-3
  • Be available during USA business hours and occasionally on weekends when client launches require it

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience managing client accounts in a fast-paced agency, SaaS company, or startup
  • Fluent English speaker with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • You've worked in high-pressure environments before and didn't crack under the weight
  • You're organized, proactive, and don't need someone checking in on you every 2 hours
  • You don't let things fall through the cracks—you follow up, you track details, you close loops
  • Experience with project management tools like ClickUp, Asana, or similar
  • Comfortable working remotely, but you don't treat "remote" like "invisible"
  • Bonus: Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization (not required, but helpful)

What we offer:

  • Compensation: $12/hour ($2,000+/month full-time) + performance bonuses (depending on experience)
  • Fully remote—work from anywhere as long as you're available US hours
  • Work with real scaling brands, not broke startups or tire-kickers
  • Small team, so you'll have real impact and visibility
  • You'll learn more in 6 months here than 2 years at a slow-moving corporate job
  • Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the agency scales

How to apply:

Don't send a resume first.

Record a 4-minute Loom video (free tool, Google it if you don't know it) and tell us:

  1. Why you want this job
  2. Why we should hire you
  3. A time you had to manage a difficult client situation and how you handled it

Then email the Loom link to:

Subject line must include the word BUILDER. If it doesn't, we'll assume you can't follow instructions and we won't read your application.

If you can't handle recording a 4-minute video, you definitely can't handle this role.

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A foi criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana:

TRADIÇÃO EM CRESCER

Apesar das dificuldades políticas e econômicas da época, a empresa estabeleceu uma tradição em crescer, valorizando o trabalho em equipe e as habilidades individuais dos colaboradores em um ambiente onde todos se sentem orgulhosos de construir uma história de solidez e grandes conquistas.

title: Senior Ai Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.

The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.

What you'll do

- Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

- Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

- Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

- Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

- Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

- Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

- Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

- Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

- Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

- Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.

Required Qualifications:

- 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

- You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

- You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

- You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

- You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

- You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

- You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

- You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

- You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

- You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.

Preferred Qualifications:

- You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

- You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

- You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

- You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

- You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Professor De Inglês

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo residents)

Compensation Currency: Brazilian Real (BRL)

Contract: Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week

About Us

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.

Role Purpose

This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and NetSuite (the team's go-forward systems);
    willingness and abilityto learn additional legacy systems as needed
  • Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required
  • High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems
  • Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support

Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management

  • Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases
  • Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments
  • Monitor licence allocation and usage;
    identify under- or over-utilised licences
  • Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased;
    audit and reconcile entitlements
  • Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions
  • Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility
  • Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements

Billing & Invoice Support

  • Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution
  • Investigate disputed charges and resolve invoice discrepancies, explaining charges, credits, and taxes clearly
  • Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval of credit notes raised by other areas
  • Validate contract pricing and entitlements against billing records
  • Handle invoice, statement, and contract copy requests

Data Quality & Master Data Management

  • Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of customer, billing, and entitlement records
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies and remove duplicate records
  • Validate data against source systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, and other platforms) and contractual agreements
  • Coordinate master data updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms
  • Process changes in billing frequency, currency, and historical contract corrections

Reconciliation, Change & Escalation Management

  • Reconcile data between systems and investigate root causes of mismatches
  • Support customer mergers, acquisitions, and organisational/account hierarchy changes
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Technical Support on business-critical issues
  • Own priority investigation and escalation of entitlement and data issues within defined SLAs

Reporting

  • Contribute to entitlement summaries, licence position, and renewal/expiry reporting (with the BI team)
  • Support data quality scorecards, customer data health assessments, and root-cause reporting

Service Expectations

  • Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies;
    flag gaps before they affect the customer
  • Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability
  • Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs
  • Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

Results

title: Project Manager
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A função abrange sistemas de racks e gabinetes, infraestrutura de energia, sistemas relacionados à refrigeração, cabeamento e outras instalações de suporte em ambientes de IDC e data centers.

We are looking for a Project Manager with experience in IDC facilities and data center physical infrastructure to support technical coordination, project implementation, and delivery. Project-based cooperation. The work scope, location, schedule, and compensation will be confirmed before each project begins.

Nossos valores são aplicados em nosso dia a dia e fazem a diferença em nossos resultados. Se você acredita que crescimento movimenta, o cliente deve estar no centro, tecnologia e simplicidade dão certo, foco com colaboração e coragem desafiam o óbvio;

title: Remote Investment Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side.
  • Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion.
  • Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents.
  • Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits.
  • Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds.
  • Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast;
    your documents still close cleanly.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Head Of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety;
    disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

  • Realizar revisão de código fonte com foco em segurança e orientar boas práticas (validação de input/output, autenticação/autorização, gestão de segredos).
  • Liderar a condução de avaliações de segurança na arquitetura e construção de plataformas seguras com expertise de identificar fragilidades técnicas e em regras de negócio atuando como enabler e não como blocker (Security by Design)
  • Liderar um programa de Security Champions e ações de conscientização para desenvolvedores.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e avaliar controles e processos de Segurança da Informação, visando a melhoria contínua e a aderência a PCI-DSS, BACEN e LGPD.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida em segurança de aplicações e/ou segurança ofensiva, atuando próximo aos times de desenvolvimento.
  • Desenvolvimento seguro / DevSecOps: experiência prática integrando SAST e DAST ao CI/CD e conduzindo gestão de vulnerabilidades.
  • Modelagem de ameaças: vivência com STRIDE e priorização de riscos por probabilidade e impacto.
  • Ferramentas SAST/DAST/SCA (ex.: VeraCode, Checkmarx, SonarQube, Snyk, OWASP ZAP) e ferramentas de pentest (ex.: Burp Suite, Nmap, SemGrep, Trivy e correlatas open-source).
  • Frameworks: OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, OWASP LLM, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, CIS, SANS.
  • Stack: conhecimento de frameworks JavaScript modernos, Node.Js com TypeScript e React (aderência ao que a Conta Simples usa).
  • Soft skills: mentalidade empreendedora (self-starter), muita energia, excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, trabalho em equipe e sinergia com desenvolvedores.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando em áreas de Tecnologia (Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Segurança da Informação ou correlatas), não é primordial.

Será diferencial se você tiver:

  • Engajamento com a comunidade (CTF, bug bounty, papers e write-ups).

title: Dgb Americas Training Manager South Latam
description:
DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM

DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty

Location : Brazil

Reporting to: Education Senior Manager

Role Mission

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories

The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region.

Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories.
  • Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital).
  • Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities.
  • Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.
  • Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities.
  • Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.

2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building

  • Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM.
  • Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer.
  • Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements.
  • Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs.

3. Brand & Product Expertise

  • Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge.
  • Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation.
  • Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets.
  • Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints.
  • Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines.

5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.).
  • Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance.
  • Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach.

Requirements & Skills

  • 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LATAM markets
  • Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese .
  • Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

title: Sales Ninja Wanted: Turn Refund Requests Into Retained Revenue
description:
Do Not Apply If You Do Not Speak Professional Level of English

We are a fast-growing travel facilitation company processing thousands of applications per month across multiple destinations including the United Kingdom, Thailand and Aruba. We are looking for a sharp, persuasive Customer Support Specialist to join our team and take ownership of refund disputes, chargeback defence and escalated customer communications. This is a role for someone who knows how to read people, handle objections, and turn a customer who wants their money back into one who feels understood and stays with us.

What you will be doing

  • Handling inbound refund and cancellation requests across email, and looking for the angle that resolves them in the company's favour without leaving the customer feeling unheard
  • Drafting professional, firm and legally informed responses to customer disputes
  • Managing chargeback defence submissions with supporting evidence packages
  • Liaising with payment processors on disputed transactions
  • Maintaining accurate case notes and escalating where necessary
  • Working closely with our Senior Paralegal team on complex cases

What we are looking for

  • Background in appointment setting, sales, or a closing-focused role, you know how to handle objections and guide a conversation to an outcome
  • A genuine interest in human psychology and what actually moves someone from "no" to "yes"
  • Excellent written English with strong attention to tone and detail
  • Comfortable negotiating outcomes rather than just reciting policy
  • Ability to stay calm, professional and firm under pressure
  • Familiarity with consumer protection frameworks is a strong advantage
  • Experience working with payment processors such as Stripe, Wise or similar
  • Ability to work independently and manage a high volume of cases
  • Previous experience in travel, legal support, e-commerce, or high-ticket sales is preferred
  • Love for performance

What we offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Fast-paced and dynamic environment with real ownership of your role
  • Direct collaboration with senior leadership

If you know how to read a room, handle an objection, and turn a tense conversation into a win for both sides, we want to hear from you.

Apply by sending your CV and a short cover letter explaining a time you talked someone into, or out of, something. Put "pink flamingo" in the subject so I know you read this far.

title: Remote Real Estate Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios.
  • Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M&A and financing transactions.
  • Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house.
  • Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments.
  • Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics.
  • Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals.
  • Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Director Of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required;
    Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required;
    English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum;
    MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:

  • Somos totalmente focados em crescimento.
  • Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade.
  • Vencemos juntos, com diversão.
  • Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales teams and customers to understand business challenges, design technical solutions, and demonstrate the value of Quortex technologies. You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process, helping customers evaluate architectural options and achieve their business objectives.

This position combines technical expertise, customer engagement, solution design, and business consulting. You will work with telecommunications operators, broadcasters, media companies, streaming providers, and technology partners to design innovative video delivery and streaming solutions.

Professional proficiency in English is required. Portuguese and Spanish language skills are highly desirable to support customer engagement and business growth across the region.

Customer Engagement and Solution Consulting

  • Partner with Sales teams to develop customer strategies and solution approaches.
  • Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into tailored solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, from technical teams to executive decision-makers.
  • Communicate the business value, expected return on investment, and strategic benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Conduct technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops.

Solution Design and Technical Leadership

  • Design and present solution architectures across the Quortex portfolio, including SaaS, public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, and on-premises offerings.
  • Recommend scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures aligned with customer objectives.
  • Design solutions covering end-to-end video processing, delivery, monitoring, and distribution workflows.
  • Advise customers on cloud video workflows, scalability, content delivery, recording, and monitoring.
  • Translate customer requirements and market feedback into recommendations that can contribute to product roadmaps.
  • Support customers with architectural decisions and video workflow migration to the cloud.

Pre-Sales Support

  • Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Lead and support Proof of Concept activities, translating customer needs into clear technical use cases and success criteria.
  • Participate in RFP and RFI processes.
  • Prepare technical proposals and responses to customer requirements.
  • Create solution documentation, architecture diagrams, and supporting technical materials.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to Linux, networking, video systems, and system integrations during demonstrations and Proofs of Concept.

Business Development and Market Engagement

  • Contribute to territory planning and account strategies.
  • Support lead-generation activities through customer engagement, webinars, presentations, events, and technical content.
  • Collaborate with partners, resellers, systems integrators, and other ecosystem stakeholders to develop joint opportunities.
  • Represent Quortex at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events when required.
  • Participate as an exhibitor or speaker at relevant industry events, depending on experience and business needs.

Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales teams.

  • Help connect customer needs with product capabilities and future roadmap opportunities.
  • Share technical knowledge and best practices across the organization.

What we’re looking for

Mandatory Technical Experience

  • Knowledge of end-to-end video workflows, including:

Ingest

Encoding and transcoding

Statistical multiplexing, or statmux

Adaptive Bitrate Streaming, or ABR

Over-the-Top delivery, or OTT

Direct-to-Home distribution, or DTH

Primary distribution

Cable distribution

  • Experience troubleshooting Linux environments, networking, and system integrations.
  • Knowledge of public and private cloud architectures applied to video workflows.
  • Experience designing or deploying cloud-based video solutions.
  • Ability to conduct Proofs of Concept, from understanding customer requirements to defining the proposed solution and success criteria.
  • Ability to translate customer needs and technical feedback into product and roadmap recommendations.
  • Experience participating in RFP or RFI processes and preparing technical proposals.
  • Understanding of video processing, packaging, compression, content delivery, and streaming technologies.
  • Experience with live and on-demand video architectures.
  • Ability to design and explain technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable Technical Experience

  • Knowledge of advertising technologies and video monetization models.
  • Experience with Server-Side Ad Insertion, or SSAI.
  • Familiarity with Server-Guided Ad Insertion, or SGAI, and Dynamic Ad Insertion, or DAI.
  • Experience with hybrid environments and the migration of video workflows to the cloud.

SMPTE ST 2110

SCTE-35

SCTE-224

Differentiators

  • Systems Integration and Consulting
